title: FORGE suggestion consent
description: Closed local contract recording the operator's go-ahead for one exact payload. The token binds the payload digest, the adapter executable digest, the model identifier and the retention notice, so any change between preview and run invalidates it. Runtime validation additionally rejects decoded duplicate keys, nulls and an unsupported version.
$comment: Runtime enforces a 256 KiB byte limit, depth 8, a 16 KiB UTF-8 string bound, lowercase SHA-256 digests, a bounded operator-supplied model identifier and a kebab-case operator key. Consent is required even though the adapter is local.
